topic: What antenna design considerations minimize signal attenuation in high-noise power line environments for reliable PLC integration?
consensus_response: To minimize signal attenuation, antenna design should focus on impedance matching, material selection, and geometry optimization. Directional antennas can reduce EMI, while polarization diversity enhances signal robustness. Adaptive impedance tuning can dynamically adjust antenna impedance, further optimizing signal transmission.
reference_context: PLC faces challenges like signal attenuation, distortion, and security concerns due to power line noise and lack of regulations.
